name: Dan's Birthday Surprise
source:
On Dan's birthday, you and his friends must resolve a great mystery, Interact with and chat with various characters and uncover the truth! Dan's Birthday Surprise is a short and simple light hearted game with a few short but fun endings.


You play as ███████████, it is unclear where you came from or why you've been given the responsibility of resolving this mystery, but you haven't much else to do, so might as well.

[from [url=https://lewis-the-fool.itch.io/dans-birthday-surprise]Itch.io[/url]]
